thread:
alex: Heads-up — big enterprise ask from Cloudwave: they want a hybrid pricing model. committed baseline + per-route burst credits + an add-on for dedicated SLA. can we sketch constraints?

maya: TLDR of their ask?

alex: They need: 1) 1.5M token monthly commit, 2) per-route burst (up to 3x baseline for 1 hour/day), 3) a dedicated SLA add-on at 99.9 with soft isolation, and 4) graduated overage pricing (tiered discounts).

jordan: Sounds like combo of reserved capacity + burst credits + SLA add-on. product-wise we already have reserved + burst credits idea, SLA add-on is new scope.

liam: From infra: bursts are doable if we gate at account-level and have fallback routing. but 3x sustained for an hour is heavy — need explicit burst pool and throttles. cost impact needs modeling.

finance-bot: Quick note: floor commit required for enterprise deals: minimum $25k/mo ARR or agree to annual commit. also recommend explicit overage caps to protect margins.

maya: Negotiation levers: 1) increase commit to avoid big burst pools, 2) limit burst frequency (e.g., 1 hour/week not /day), 3) add per-burst fee, 4) require minimum annual term for SLA. which of these are blockers?

sara: From sales: Cloudwave won't accept 1.5M commit up front — they expect flexible ramp. they prefer monthly commit with true-up and burst credits on top.

natalie-legal: Need to be careful: SLA add-on with isolation implies stronger indemnities and security commitments. if private deployment required, on-prem terms and data residency clauses kick in. costs must be reflected in contract language.

alex: Proposal: product MVP: "Flex Reserve" = monthly commit + purchasable burst credits bucket (prepaid), burst policy: 2x baseline for up to 2 hours/day, automatic fallback to hosted model (lower perf) once credits exhausted. SLA add-on as separate alpha: 99.9 uptime, priority support, optional dedicated pool (extra charge).

liam: Technically we can implement credits + fallback within 6 weeks if we surface routing policy and throttles. dedicated pool needs capacity planning (separate infra ticket).

jordan: For launch criteria: 1) clear pricing tables with examples, 2) billing flow supports prepaid credit buckets + auto top-up, 3) console shows per-route credit usage, 4) canary with 1 pilot customer, 5) legal sign-off on SLA text.

maya: I can own pricing spec and examples. alex you own sales negotiation playbook. liam + eng infra own implementation plan. natalie, can you draft the SLA add-on contract sketch? finance-bot: please run the unit economics once we pick rates.

natalie-legal: I'll draft a short-form SLA add-on and outline the liabilities for dedicated pools. need inputs: expected monthly revenue for pilot, and target overage caps.

finance-bot: Running quick scenario: if baseline commit $20k/mo and burst credits priced at $0.05/token, 2x burst for 2 hours/day for a mid-sized customer becomes ~+40% marginal cost in peak week. recommend premium of 25-35% for SLA add-on.

sara: Sales ask: give us one variant without annual lock to close pilot. add option to convert to annual with discount.

alex: Decision meeting Tuesday 11am to finalize price bands and commit thresholds. action items: maya: draft price bands + three example customer scenarios by Mon EOD; liam: infra feasibility doc + rough cost estimate; natalie: SLA contract sketch; finance-bot: ECON scenarios for each band.

maya: noted. I'll include a conservative burst limit and an aggressive variant for negotiation.

jordan: We'll also add a dashboard requirement to product OKRs so customers can see credit burn per route. helps reduce disputes.

liam: one more ops note — need a circuit-breaker metric to avoid noisy neighbor issues, propose per-route QPS cap tied to credits.

alex: great. if nothing else, I'll reconvene with Cloudwave this week with the flexible draft. :thumbsup:
